newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire suspends army chief for stepping out of line.
newsitem.headline: Zaire suspends army chief for stepping out of line.

text.p: Zaire has suspended army chief of staff General Eluki Monga for saying an international force was no longer needed in Zaire, the government said on Wednesday.
"General Eluki has been suspended because of the declarations he made," government spokesman Boguo Makeli said in a statement after the lunchtime news on state television.
Eluki told French radio on Tuesday that the intervention of a multinational force in Zaire was no longer necessary after the exodus home of nearly half a million Rwandan refugees.

A government official said Eluki also repeated complaints by the army that the government was not giving the military the means to battle Rwandan-backed Tutsi rebels who have seized much of Zaire's two eastern provinces.
The Zaire government maintains that a multinational force is still needed to help hundreds of thousands of other refugees and Zairean villagers displaced by fighting since October 18.
